decls.name: Prop38BaseFieldConstruction

paper_span.quote: Let \(F\) be the cyclic cubic field cut out by the character \(\chi=\chi_1\cdots\chi_\ell\).

decls.rationale: Step 1 of Proposition 3.8: builds the base field `F` — the first \(\ell\) primes \(r_i \equiv 1 \pmod 3\), their cyclic cubic subfields \(L_i\), the product character \(\chi = \chi_1\cdots\chi_\ell\) of conductor \(D = \prod_i r_i\), and the field it cuts out.
